text:
mia: Pushed an update to spacing tokens & button styles in the draft component file. TL;DR: compressed small spacing token (sp-2) from 6px->4px to match compact table rows. Can folks sanity-check button hit targets and focus states? https://inprod.redwood/tokens/branch

alex: quick scan — compact spacing looks good for dense tables but worried about button touch targets on mobile. Are we keeping min 44x44? :thinking:

sam: yeah mobile concern. If we reduce padding we should still enforce min-width/min-height. Suggest adding CSS var `--interactive-min: 44px`. Also table row density: can we have tokens for 'dense' vs 'normal'?

mia: good call. I added `--interactive-min` and updated tokens: `--sp-2: 4px`, `--sp-3: 8px`. snippet:
```
:root {
  --sp-2: 4px;
  --sp-3: 8px;
  --interactive-min: 44px;
}
```

jordan: on focus ring: current 2px blue outline fails contrast tests when button bg is dark. Could we use 3px semi-opaque white for dark backgrounds and 2px solid brand on light? Also add `:focus-visible` only.

harper: accessibility nit — hit target isn't just width/height, but padding for click target. Use `min-inline-size` + `min-block-size` and `touch-action` properly. Also toasts: current auto-dismiss 3500ms feels fast for longer messages. Recommend 4500-6000ms depending on length and reduced-motion respect.

alex: agree re toasts. Propose base `toast-duration-short: 3000`, `toast-duration-default: 5000`, `toast-duration-long: 8000`. And add `prefers-reduced-motion` to disable slide animation.

design-bot: Updated tokens file at https://inprod.redwood/tokens/branch, new PR #1289

mia: thanks all. Next steps: I'll update PR with `--interactive-min`, toast durations, dense table tokens, and focus rules that vary by bg. @jordan @harper can you +1 the accessibility changes? planning to merge EOD.

jordan: +1 :+1:

harper: +1, just one tiny wording tweak in the docs: "hit target" -> "interactive target" for clarity.

sam: also mention in migration notes that compact tables may change row heights by 2px.

mia: added migration note. merging after doc tweak. :shipit:
